newsitem.title: USA: Barney's to take $51.4 mln charge to reorganize.
newsitem.headline: Barney's to take $51.4 mln charge to reorganize.

text.p: Barney's Inc said on Thursday that it would take a one-time charge of $51.4 million against its April earnings for reorganization costs.

The reorganization plan includes closing Barney's 17th Street store in New York, as well as stores in Dallas, Houston, and Troy, Michigan, Barney's said in a statement. After the closings, the upscale fashion retailer will have nine stores and ten outlets across the United States, it said.
Barney's reported a net loss of $56.3 million for the four-week period ended May 3, including the charge. The charge includes provisions for severance, lease rejections and store asset write-downs.
